summary: Validated new Ajustes page + series-driven numbering end-to-end. Backend: 5/5 pytest for /api/ajustes GET/PUT and series counter increments for facturas, pedidos de venta y de compra. Frontend: Ajustes page renders empresa form, both SeriesEditor tables (venta 3 counters, compra 2 counters), add/delete/mark-default work, Guardar cambios persists across reload. FacturasEmitidas dialog input-serie is a SELECT populated from series_venta ['A','B'] with default 'A'. Documentos (Pedidos/Albaranes) dialog input-serie-doc is a SELECT populated from series_venta on 'De venta' tab (['A','B']) and series_compra on 'De compra' tab (['C']), with the default preselected. Dashboard, Clientes, Facturas Recibidas, Pedidos, Albaranes render with the indigo/zinc redesign and no console errors.

minor.issue: Returns 405 Method Not Allowed — no way to remove test/erroneous facturas emitidas. Test data accumulates (~20 TEST_ rows). If deletion is intentionally disabled for Verifactu compliance, consider an explicit rectificativa-only flow; if not, add DELETE handler.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid mismatch vs review-request spec: renders 'empresa-codigo_postal' + 'empresa-iban', missing 'empresa-cp', 'empresa-provincia', 'empresa-pais'. Not a functional bug but the Ajustes form omits Provincia and País fields that the request assumed exist.

issues: Header cell 'PRÓX. FACTURA / PEDIDO / ALBARÁN' visible OK. Alignment fine. Star (default) and trash buttons render with good hover states — no issues.
Single-month bar chart is fine but tall for one bar — cosmetic only.

action_items: Decide whether to add Provincia / País (and rename codigo_postal→cp) in Ajustes, or update the spec/testids to match current implementation.
Consider allowing DELETE /api/facturas-emitidas for TEST_ / error records (currently 405).

(Optional) In Ajustes save(), skip empty-nombre series silently instead of blocking save; today adding a serie and immediately clicking Guardar triggers 'Todas las series de venta necesitan un nombre'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _get_ajustes correctly seeds a singleton {series_venta:[A default], series_compra:[C default]}. _siguiente_contador uses find_one_and_update with $inc — atomic and race-safe. Good.

_numero_documento formats 'A-2026-0005' / 'C-2026-0005' for pedidos+albaranes and _emitir_factura uses serie+YEAR+padded counter (A2026-0026). Verified counters increment: TSTF facturas 500→501, TSTPV pedidos 200→201, TSTPC pedidos 300→301.
Ajustes.jsx save() validation is strict (blocks save if any serie has empty nombre). This is a UX foot-gun right after clicking 'Añadir serie'.
FacturasEmitidas.jsx and Documentos.jsx: input-serie / input-serie-doc render as native <select>, correctly repopulate when switching venta/compra tabs.
Layout.jsx nav-ajustes correctly listed under SISTEMA section.
test_credentials: License-key gate only, REACT_APP_LICENSE_KEY=NEXO-DEMO-0001 already in frontend/.env
seed_data_creation: Created + cleaned ephemeral series TSTV/TSTF/TSTPV/TSTPC and reverted empresa.nombre to 'Mi Empresa SL' with counters A.facturas=27, C.pedidos=6. ~20 pre-existing TEST_ facturas emitidas could not be deleted (endpoint returns 405) but are historical and don't affect current features.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GET/PUT /api/ajustes verified. Series-driven numbering verified for facturas emitidas, pedidos de venta y de compra. Delete facturas-emitidas is 405 by design(?). Ajustes UI omits Provincia/País; keys used are codigo_postal + iban.
